rubric.role_summary: Senior, hands-on brand art direction role for a consumer beverage business, spanning packaging production, retail and ecommerce creative, photography direction, and design-team leadership.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior, hands-on brand art direction role for a consumer beverage business, spanning packaging production, retail and ecommerce creative, photography direction, and design-team leadership.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 7+ years of professional design experience.
- 2+ years of experience providing art direction or leading designers.
- Hands-on packaging and print design experience.
- Experience with ecommerce or digital design.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Design experience in CPG, food and beverage, beauty, wellness, lifestyle, or another highly visual consumer category.
- Deep packaging and print design experience encompassing dielines, production artwork, prepress, proofing, and work with production partners.
- Experience designing for retail environments, including point-of-sale materials, displays, shippers, endcaps, and signage.
- Understanding of ecommerce and digital design, including PDPs, campaign assets, and omnichannel launches.
- Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.
- Experience directing photography and external creative partners.
- Project management skills for managing multiple launches across functions.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: USA (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
